indexer.title: BigBridge QuickNav Search Index
indexer.description: Compiles the QuickNav admin search index (system.xml/menu.xml navigation entries, and in future products/categories) so search results are served from a flat table instead of parsing configuration on every request.

indexer.title: QuickNav Product Search Index (OpenSearch)
indexer.description: Narrows QuickNav product search to candidate IDs via OpenSearch n-gram matching. Falls back to the unmodified full scan when unavailable.
